description: This file contains unit tests for the AdbConfig component in the Android Open Source Project, utilizing Google Test framework and dependency injection via Fruit. It tests setting configuration modes from flags and serializing/deserializing configuration data.

classes.name: TestData
classes.description: A structure used for dependency injection containing references to AdbConfig and AdbConfigFragment.

methods.name: TestComponent
methods.description: Creates a dependency injection component that installs various AdbConfig related modules.
